amis-titv-news.note: TITV Amis evening news - Chinese dialogue subtitle painted straight onto the footage, so the dark-outline test is required. The box is tall because the subtitle uses two heights: y=786..838 normally, and y=730..778 over letterboxed clips. It stops at y=844 on purpose - the red lower-third starts at y=846, and its Amis keyword and reporter name would otherwise be read as dialogue. 切 cue ê遮罩：`scale` 2（半解析，每格 17.62→3.67 ms，四集ê切割品質三个指標攏佇雜訊範圍內）；`compare_cols` 1250–1790 是「置右字幕比對遮罩」——27 集量ê墨水右緣中位數 1735–1737、標準差 31–70 px（左緣是 460–470），所以只比字真正khiā ê彼塊，重覆對降 44–69% 而且吞句同時降；`compare_rows` 4–114 kā帶頂尾ê留白剪掉。`sheet.row_slots` 是「字幕上下位置判斷法」：分界列 65、pad 6，兩位墨水比細過 2.0 就退轉去全高——彼條退路防ê毋是「兩列攏是字幕」（掃 3,339 條無這款），是畫面家己ê字（布條、報紙、圖卡）佮字幕搶仝一條圖條。

titv-news.note: TITV 族語新聞. Chinese dialogue subtitle painted onto the footage, so the dark-outline test is required.
